newsitem.title: CROATIA: Insolvency and debts rising in Croatia - paper.
newsitem.headline: Insolvency and debts rising in Croatia - paper.

text.p: The number of insolvent companies in Croatia and indebtedness is rising, according to Central Payments Bureau figures published in Vecernji List daily on Wednesday.
There were 17,822 insolvent companies in February, 1.46 percent up from January. Their overall debt in Feburary rose 5.95 percent to 8.56 billion kuna, the daily said.
Some 90 percent of the insolvencies are private companies, whose share in the overall debts amounts to 62 percent, or 5.3 billion kuna, Vecernji List said.
The number of workers employed by all the debtors shrank by 3.88 percent, totalling 159,142 people in Febrary.
